next.reason: 1985: reference modification 'is evaluated immediately after evaluation of the subscripts', or without subscripts 'at the time subscripting would be evaluated' (§1985:IV.4.3.8.3.4 GR3). 2023 item identification evaluates, in order, subscript evaluation (§2023:14.6.4 GR4) and later reference modification (§2023:14.6.4 GR7), and item identification is done 'as the first step in the evaluation of that identifier'. The steps between them (object property evaluation, length of an occurs-depending group) are absent from 1985 programs or have no side effect, so reference modification is still evaluated directly after the subscripts, or where they would be. Same result.
